{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Emerald green silk blouse with a relaxed fit and a slightly dropped shoulder cut to length at the hips, color #50c878, fabric.
High-waisted charcoal wool-blend trousers in a wide-leg silhouette that falls just above the ankle, color #36454f, fabric.
Tan leather loafers with a low block heel and a soft sole for quiet movement, color #c19a6b, fabric.
Thin gold link bracelet to catch the restaurant's artificial light against her warm skin tones, color #ffd700, fabric.
This outfit balances the casual atmosphere of a date night at a casual restaurant with an elegant autumnal palette that complements her hair and eyes. The relaxed blouse ensures comfort during a two-hour evening engagement while the tailored trousers maintain a polished social look appropriate for a guest role. Warm neutral tones in the shoes ground the vibrant top, creating a cohesive ensemble that feels both intentional and effortlessly stylish."}
